images.seen: A woman on a high apartment balcony watching lightning fork over the suburbs at a burning sunset, wet street and small umbrellas far below. Monday.
lines: The balcony beats the couch when the sky is doing this.
Sunset on one side, artillery on the other, and she has the balcony.
The storm is doing the rounds of the suburbs and saving town for last.

images.seen: A dark estate street at dusk, lightning glowing inside the cloud, palms bending in the wind, windows lit by candles. Wednesday.
lines: Candles in the windows: the storm has already had a word with the power.
The palms are pointing the way the storm is going, which is this way.
Lightning inside the cloud: the storm is still deciding where to put it.

images.seen: Two lightning bolts striking the sea beyond storm surf on a rocky coast, orange sunset squeezed under the purple cloud. Sunday.
lines: The sea is taking the strikes tonight so the land doesn't have to.
Sunset tried to happen; the storm had other bookings for that sky.
The waves were the show until the sky decided otherwise.

images.seen: A zinc bucket in the hallway catching a slow ceiling drip, folded towel beside it, the rainy garden visible through the open door. Friday.
lines: The roof has an opinion tonight and the bucket is taking minutes.
One drip, one bucket, one towel: the storm has made it indoors, barely.
Somewhere up there the rain found a way in, and it is being managed.
